name: .NET / C#
desc: Complete mid-senior interview mastery: OOP depth, async state machines, C# 14, ASP.NET Core 10, EF Core 10, Memory/GC diagnostics, CQRS, RabbitMQ/Kafka, SCIM 2.0, and System Design.
tip: When designing something live, narrate your decisions — "I'd make this Scoped because it needs a fresh DbContext per request." At 4 YOE, reasoning is what's graded.

r: Abstract = state + partial impl. Interface = contract (C# 8+ has default methods but no fields).
Never — exceptions crash the process. Always use async Task.
Scoped injected into Singleton breaks per-request isolation. ASP.NET Core throws in dev.
Read-only queries — typically 20–40% faster, no change tracking overhead.
Loop accessing navigation property = 1 query per iteration. Fix with .Include().
EF Core DbContext is already a Unit of Work. Extra wrapper is usually redundant.
